§7.3.11 Stamps

📄 Page rule — applied from the page alone

text-stamps · text marks legal

✅ Normative

Ink applied over or beside the printed page — overprinted, boxed or rotated, or in a different ink — MUST be rendered as [stamp: its words], exactly as printed, at its place in reading order. A stamp with no legible words MUST be rendered as [stamp]. The page's own printed text is never a stamp, however official it looks.

A stamp records an act on this page: FILED, RECEIVED, PAID, APPROVED, a court e-filing line laid across the header, a clerk's dated box. It was added after the page was printed, and it is recognised by that: it overprints the page's text, sits in a box or at an angle the page's layout does not use, or is in a different ink.

Requirements

  • A stamp is written with the protocol's bracket marker, [stamp: …], carrying its words exactly as printed; a stamp on several lines is one marker, its lines joined with a space.
  • It keeps its place in reading order. Where it overprints other text, the marker comes first, then the text beneath it — see Overlapping Text§7.3.6. Over a table it stays outside the table — see Handwriting and Stamps§9.6.5.
  • A stamp whose words cannot be read is the bare [stamp].
  • A round seal is [seal: …] — see Seals and Round Stamps§7.3.9. A watermark, background text that describes the whole document, is [watermark: …] — see Watermarks§7.3.13. The three share one bracket shape because each is ink laid on the page; they keep separate names because a watermark describes the document while a stamp or seal records an act on this page.
  • Header text that the page prints itself — a filing header, an official form number — is ordinary text, not a stamp.

✅ Sample — a clerk's stamps over a filing header

The boxed FILED is stamped over the header's own FILED:, and Index #: E2026004417 over the header's INDEX NO. E2026004417. The two stamps become markers, each first at its overlap; the header's own lines stay text.

Expected Markdown · excerpt, the header

[stamp: FILED]

FILED: HALVERSTON COUNTY CLERK 03/14/2026 11:05 AM

[stamp: Index #: E2026004417]

INDEX NO. E2026004417
